rule: A Cosmos account sequence is accepted only as the next one: COSMOS-SUPPORT.md ("gaps and repeats refuse before hardware use"), POLICY.md (rule sequence: "it is not the next account sequence"), e2e/README.md ("a skipped or reused account sequence").

divergent.why: EtcdState and opstate.py's transition take any HIGHER sequence; the documents and FileState take only the next. Which is right is the owner's decision (regalia-07k). Each pair listed here must STILL diverge: a test fails when one starts to match, so the fix also removes its pair.
